deadline.value: January 1 is the last date to submit an application for full consideration for fall admission.
deadline.quote: January 1st is the last date to submit an application for full consideration for fall admission that year. March 31st is the last day to start an application for the fall, and October 31st is the last day for the following spring.

gre_general.value: General GRE requirement is not stated.

gre_subject.value: GRE math subject test is strongly recommended.
gre_subject.quote: GRE math subject test is strongly recommended

supervisor.value: Pre-application supervisor requirement is not stated.

funding.value: All about five incoming Mathematical Sciences PhD students accepted each year are fully funded.
funding.quote: We accept about five new doctoral students in our PhD in mathematical sciences each year, all of whom are fully funded, and maintain a team of about 25 PhD candidates.

entry_route.value: Students entering with a BS complete 90 semester hours, while students entering with an MS complete 60 semester hours.
entry_route.quote: Students entering the program with a BS must successfully complete 90 semester hours of graduate work (students with an MS must complete 60 semester hours).

toefl_min.value: For PhD applicants, minimum TOEFL is 100.
toefl_min.quote: For PhD applicants, a TOEFL minimum score of 100 (internet based) or an IELTS band score of 7.5 is required.

ielts_min.value: For PhD applicants, minimum IELTS is 7.5.
ielts_min.quote: For PhD applicants, a TOEFL minimum score of 100 (internet based) or an IELTS band score of 7.5 is required.
